title: Catalog release with behaviour files, two identities, typed payloads and provenance
description: Adds optional behaviour materials, contentSha256/behaviourSha256 identities, typed payloads, framework identity, provenance and measured sizes. All new fields are optional; recipes and item ids are unchanged. Like release 1.5, the release carries its baseline binding. The reader recomputes behaviour bytes and both identities.
